The '''charged-particle blaster''' was a type of [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] weapon used aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]].

==Description==
Based on its name, the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon fired charged particles at a target.

==Appearances==
